title: Multilingual Jailbreak-Intention Probe: Does One Direction Cover Many Tongues?

original_idea.body: Early-step safety steering dosing (extends arXiv:2602.11096): sweep number of early steered steps and strength on an open reasoning model; map jailbreak-block vs benign GSM8K accuracy heatmap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping the safe operating region of a cheap inference-time defense is a concrete, deployment-relevant chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation steering + 2D sweep + GSM8K check; refusal-direction extraction adds modest depth.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused safety-vs-utility heatmap; two-axis sweep is a single bounded experiment.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Inference-time steering on open weights, lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: Single open model inference with steering.

novelty.reasoning: Source claims few-step recovery but not the dosing tradeoff map; likely mostly novel.
